descriptionChirho: To commit adultery as a basic action, in Qal finite verb forms including imperfect and consecutive imperfect.
To commit adultery with intensive or habitual force, in Piel finite verb forms including imperfect and perfect.
The act of committing adultery expressed as infinitive absolute, used adverbially to emphasize or as a verbal noun denoting the activity itself.
A man who commits adultery, from substantivized masculine singular and plural participles in both Qal and Piel stems.
A woman who commits adultery, from substantivized feminine singular and plural participles in both Qal and Piel stems.
